method: Pearson of log1p(CP10K); intercept + log1p(total UMI minus LYPLA1) + log1p(nDetected minus LYPLA1 detection); state dummies sensitivity
admission: >=100 cells,>=10 LYPLA1 positive,nonconstant target; gene>=1% eligible cells in cohort and >=max(10,1% cells) per donor;>=5 donors
scope: Frozen Uhlitz discovery targets plus focus, not all transcriptome; no BRCA matrices rerun
selection: No P or FDR gate for cross-cancer descriptive comparison; report >=0.1 effect and >=70% direction separately
